main_text.p: latinus additus est. Luctatius « consul & Q. Valerius prætor « circa Siciliam insignem Pœ-« norum classem deleuerant, « quo nomine Luctatio confu« li triumphum senatus decre-« uit. Cum autem Valerius sibi « eum quoque decerni deside-« raret, negauit id fieri oporte-« re Luctatius, ne in honore tri« umphi minor potestas maio« ri æquaretur. pertinaciusque« progressa contentione, Vale-« rius sponsione Luctatiū pro-« uocauit, non se petiturū triũ-« phũ, ni suo duētu Punica clas« sis esset oppressa: nec dubita-« uit restipulari Luctatius. Ita-« queiudex inter eos conuenit «,
main_text.notes: Printed "«" marks sit at the end of each line in the column; they are transcribed as printed. Stains and specks in the right margin and at the lower left (".:" and dots near "conuenit") are not printed text and are left out. Long s was read as plain s throughout. The word "Ita-" is hyphenated at the line end and continues as "queiudex" on the next line, transcribed as "Ita-queiudex"; "iudex" is written "judex" under the i/j rule. The running head ends in a letter overlapped by a mark, which may be M; it is marked [?]. The text continues on the next page after the catchword "At-".
